scope_note: First-class pane feature manifests for Project, Match, Performance, Settings, and Metrics plus browser-owned support-surface manifests for Landing, shared shell, and the current Stage tool families: Compose, Score, Splits / waveform, Markers / Review / Overlay, Export, and ShotML. Project/Match/Performance remain the proven Wave A base; Settings and Metrics extend that same pane model; the landing/shared-shell rows and Stage tool rows stay support-only and do not create first-class TAX-2 view closure. These records bind TAX-0 feature IDs to TAX-1 pane IDs for the pane slice and to current browser support surfaces for the landing/shared-shell plus Stage tool slice. They are not evidence closeout records.

control-led.description: Use when a feature has explicit browser control identifiers that must stay mapped to the pane inventory.

state-led.description: Use when a feature is audited through required state, status, or result assertions instead of pane-owned control identifiers.
state-led.notes: State-led features remain first-class TAX-0 rows. Empty control_ids are intentional only when the manifest makes the state/result assertions explicit.
